question: A 20-year-old man who is a biology major presents to his physician for a simple check-up. He is informed that he hasn’t received a hepatitis B vaccine. When the first injection is applied, the medical professional informs him that he will need to come back 2 more times on assigned days, since the vaccine is given in 3 doses. Which of the following antibodies is the physician trying to increase in the college student as a result of the first vaccination?
